government_structure: Unitary, decentralised republic. National-level bodies deliver tax and customs (SUNAT), contributory pensions (ONP), health insurance (EsSalud, SIS), identity and civil registration (RENIEC; civil registration also through municipal Oficinas de Registro del Estado Civil operating under RENIEC directives), immigration (Migraciones), business and property registration (SUNARP), social programmes (MIDIS: Pension 65, Juntos) and sector licensing. Regional governments and municipalities deliver construction and operating licences, local taxes and some civil-registry and licensing functions; every entity at all three tiers must approve a TUPA (Texto Unico de Procedimientos Administrativos) under Ley 27444 and publish it in El Peruano and on gob.pe (DS 004-2023-MINAM, opened on El Peruano, shows a TUPA modification published that way).

legal_information.name: SPIJ - Sistema Peruano de Informacion Juridica
legal_information.publisher: Ministerio de Justicia y Derechos Humanos
legal_information.note: Official digital edition of national legislation. El Peruano (10/02/2025) states it holds more than 500,000 norms, of which more than 210,000 are free access ('Normativa de Acceso Libre'); the remainder requires a paid subscription. Texts described as 'sistematizadas y actualizadas'; downloads in Word and PDF; content search and date-range search. The site returned HTTP 503 to every automated fetch in this survey, so the consolidated view and free/paid boundary could not be checked directly. No API found.
legal_information.consolidation_lag: unknown; RM 0327-2025-JUS (Sept 2025) approved guidelines for updating SPIJ (search result only)

legal_information.name: Buscador El Peruano - Normas Legales
legal_information.note: Official gazette search. Each norm has an identifier (e.g. 2162962-1) and is served as HTML full text, PDF and 'Cuadernillo'; metadata: title, publication date, norm type, number. Original texts as published, not consolidated. Free, no login. Covers decrees, ministerial resolutions and agency resolutions (e.g. ONP Resolucion Jefatural 141-2021-ONP/JF at NL/2023376-1). No API documented; the domain's safety check was rate-limited at the end of the survey.

legal_information.name: Archivo Digital de la Legislacion del Peru
legal_information.note: Laws, legislative decrees, emergency decrees and regional laws from 1904 to date, plus 19th-century legislation; a vigente / no vigente flag; search by number, date, title. Opened Ley 27444 (Documentos/Leyes/27444.pdf) and Ley 27806 (27806.pdf): both are scanned gazette PDFs of the original act (11 April 2001 and 3 August 2002), not consolidated. Includes a collection of laws in Quechua.

legal_information.name: SUNAT Legislacion (tributaria y aduanera)
legal_information.note: Agency legal portal: Resoluciones de Superintendencia by year (1996-2016 index pages at /legislacion/superin/<year>/indices/indcor.htm), tax and customs legislation sections, customs procedure manuals (see internal_guidance_examples). HTML with embedded change logs ('control de cambios').
legal_information.consolidation_lag: procedure pages carry amendment references up to RS 079-2026

catalogues.name: GOB.PE - Plataforma Digital Unica del Estado Peruano (catalogo de tramites y servicios)
catalogues.publisher: PCM - Secretaria de Gobierno y Transformacion Digital
catalogues.note: National single portal where every entity's procedures and TUPA are published (article 4 of DS 004-2023-MINAM, opened on El Peruano: 'El presente Decreto Supremo y su Anexo se publican en la Plataforma Digital Unica del Estado Peruano'). The site returned HTTP 418 to every automated fetch (including /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml), so no record could be opened and field structure, record count and any API could not be verified. Searches for a gob.pe API or TUPA open-data export found none.

catalogues.name: TUPA - Texto Unico de Procedimientos Administrativos (per entity) and SUT - Sistema Unico de Tramites
catalogues.publisher: Each entity; SUT administered by PCM Secretaria de Gestion Publica (DL 1203)
catalogues.note: Ley 27444 art. 43 (TUO DS 004-2019-JUS) obliges every public entity to approve a TUPA listing each procedure with requisitos, derecho de tramitacion, plazo, calificacion (automatic / prior evaluation with positive or negative silence) and responsible unit, in the standard format approved by PCM (DS 062-2009-PCM; RSGP 004-2020-PCM-SGP). TUPAs are approved by decree/resolution published in El Peruano and on gob.pe (DS 004-2023-MINAM opened). SUNAT's TUPA page lists TUPA editions 2007-2017 as PDFs plus a Quechua summary of main procedures. The SUT (sgp.pcm.gob.pe/sistema-unico-de-tramites/) is the official repository entities use to draft and standardise TUPAs; its page returned 503 and no public consultation or API was found.

foi.law_name: Ley 27806, Ley de Transparencia y Acceso a la Informacion Publica (TUO DS 021-2019-JUS)
proactive_publication_duties: Portal de Transparencia Estandar (DS 063-2010-PCM, opened at minedu.gob.pe copy): standard formats for management information; rubros listed on transparencia.gob.pe: Datos generales (directorio, normas emitidas, marco legal), Planeamiento y organizacion (ROF, organigrama, MAPRO/mapa de procesos, TUPA, PEI, POI), Presupuesto, Proyectos de inversion e INFObras, Participacion ciudadana, Personal, Contratacion de bienes y servicios, Actividades oficiales, Registro de visitas, Acceso a la informacion publica, Informacion focalizada

EsSalud's PTE 'Planeamiento y organizacion' page links its ROF, organigrama, 'Manual de Procedimientos (MAPRO) / Mapa de procesos institucional', TUPA, PEI and POI, showing that TUPA and procedure manuals are published under the PTE scheme
Ley 27444 art. 43: every entity must approve and publish its TUPA (procedures, requisitos, fees, plazos, calificacion) in El Peruano and on gob.pe

disclosure_platforms.name: Portal de Transparencia Estandar (PTE)
disclosure_platforms.note: Homepage: '13594 personas de 2350 entidades publican informacion en este Portal'. Per-entity pages (e.g. ?id_entidad=107 for EsSalud) link normas emitidas, instrumentos de gestion, access-to-information request statistics; no public log of individual requests or responses was found.

disclosure_platforms.name: Plataforma de Transparencia y Acceso a Informacion Publica (ANTAIP, Facilita Peru) / PAIP (OGP commitment PE0128)
disclosure_platforms.publisher: ANTAIP - Ministerio de Justicia y Derechos Humanos
disclosure_platforms.note: Government request form being rolled out entity by entity (search result; page not opened because gob.pe returns HTTP 418). ANTAIP annual report: more than 410,000 requests handled in 2025. No Alaveteli instance for Peru found; no public log of requests and answers found.

internal_guidance_practice: Yes, systematically for the main agencies, with important gaps. SUNAT publishes its customs operating procedures in full as HTML on its own site: 28 'procedimientos generales' DESPA-PG, about 20 'procedimientos asociados' DESPA-PE and 16 RECA (collection) procedures, each versioned with approving resolution, change log and roughly 100-150 numbered steps that state what 'el funcionario aduanero' does and what 'el sistema informatico' does automatically (DESPA-PG.01 v8: 'El sistema informatico asigna el canal de control, en aplicacion de tecnicas de gestion de riesgo'; DESPA-PE.00.09 v5 describes reception, assignment by the DCA head, laboratory analysis, 45-working-day deadline). EsSalud publishes 109 'Manuales de Procesos y Procedimientos' (2019-2023, PDF, listed with status) and 7 Manuales de Operaciones, plus all Gerencia General resolutions approving internal directivas (Normatividad Institucional page, 2022-2024) and a Compendio Normativo. RENIEC's new 172-page Directiva DI-001-GTAR-DRC 'Gestion Tecnica de Registros Civiles y Archivo Registral' (2026) is marked 'INFORMACION PUBLICA' and tells registrars how to qualify births, marriages, deaths and rectifications in the SIRCM system; the earlier DI-008-DRC/001 'Procedimientos del Registro Civil' is also public. ONP's pension-qualification directives (Directiva 005-2021-ONP/JF, 001-2022, 006-2022 'Calificacion de Prestaciones Previsionales del SNP', 005-2022 on fiscalizacion de expedientes, lineamientos 2026 for DL 20530 transfers) are approved by Resolucion Jefatural published with annex in El Peruano, gob.pe/onp and the PTE. Migraciones hosts its Resoluciones de Superintendencia under a 'Normativa Interna' folder on migraciones.gob.pe (RS063-2020 opened). Gaps: SUNAT's internal-tax side (tributos internos) exposes guidance (orientacion.sunat.gob.pe) and resolutions but no equivalent step-level procedure manual was found; Pension 65 directivas (DI-GOPE-01/02 'Afiliacion de Usuarios', Directiva 001-2025-MIDIS/PENSION65) are cited in published resolutions but their text sits on gob.pe, which could not be opened; descriptions of what case systems (ONP's NSP, RENIEC SIRCM, SUNAT SIGAD) do automatically appear only inside these procedures, not as separate system descriptions.

internal_guidance_examples.name: SUNAT - Procedimientos de despacho aduanero (DESPA-PG index)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Index of 28 general procedures DESPA-PG.01-29 grouped by regime (importacion, exportacion, perfeccionamiento, deposito, transito, regimenes especiales, otros) plus links to procedimientos asociados, circulares, resoluciones and derogados. Predictable URLs /legislacion/procedim/despacho/<cat>/<sub>/procGeneral/despa-pg.NN.htm.

internal_guidance_examples.name: SUNAT - DESPA-PG.01 Importacion para el Consumo (version 8)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Approved RS 084-2020, in force 31/08/2020, amended up to RS 079-2026. Sections Objetivo, Alcance, Responsabilidad, Definiciones, Base legal, Disposiciones generales A-O, Descripcion A-D (tramitacion, revision documentaria, reconocimiento fisico, regularizacion, revision post levante), ~130 numbered steps naming officer actions ('El funcionario aduanero asignado para la revision documentaria efectua las siguientes acciones') and system actions ('El sistema informatico valida los datos de la informacion transmitida').

internal_guidance_examples.name: SUNAT - Procedimientos asociados DESPA-PE (e.g. DESPA-PE.00.09 Clasificacion Arancelaria v5)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Index at /legislacion/procedim/despacho/procAsociados/index.html lists about 20 DESPA-PE procedures with version numbers. DESPA-PE.00.09 (RS 000050-2021) describes unit-level steps: Recepcion Documental assigns the expediente, 'La jefatura de la DCA asigna el expediente a un funcionario aduanero', laboratory reports in 15 working days, ruling within 45 working days, systems MPV-SUNAT, SIGAD, buzon electronico.

internal_guidance_examples.name: SUNAT - Procedimientos de recaudacion aduanera RECA-PG / RECA-PE
internal_guidance_examples.note: 4 general and 12 specific procedures: determination and control of customs debt, control de ingresos, extincion por pago, garantias, reclamos tributarios (RECA-PG.04), devoluciones (RECA-PG.05), plus linked resolutions (cobranza coactiva, FRAES) and a derogados archive.

internal_guidance_examples.name: EsSalud - Manuales de Procesos y Procedimientos
internal_guidance_examples.note: 109 numbered manuals (E01-E05 estrategicos, M01-M04 misionales, S01-S08 soporte) with unit, status (Validado / Por validar / En proceso de aprobacion), publication and update dates 2019-2023, each a PDF under /transparencia/procesos_procedimientos/ often paired with the approving resolution; includes Gerencia de Prestaciones Economicas (benefits), Gerencia Central de Logistica, hospital clinical processes.

internal_guidance_examples.name: EsSalud - Manuales de Operaciones (MOPE)
internal_guidance_examples.note: 7 operations manuals for networks and hospitals (Red Prestacional Lambayeque, Sabogal, INCOR, etc.), each with approving and amending RPE resolutions and updated text as PDF.

internal_guidance_examples.name: EsSalud - Normatividad Institucional (resoluciones de Gerencia General que aprueban directivas)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Lists Presidencia Ejecutiva and Gerencia General resolutions 2019-2024 as PDFs (e.g. RGG 943-GG-ESSALUD-2023 approving Directiva 06-GG-ESSALUD-2023 'Sistema Nacional de Cuidado Cardiovascular', 18 pages, opened). Directiva 21-GCPP-ESSALUD-2020 governs how EsSalud formulates and approves directivas and procedimientos internos. A Compendio Normativo (compendionormativo.essalud.gob.pe) exists but returned 503. The MINSA site mirrors hundreds of EsSalud resolutions 1999-2023.

internal_guidance_examples.name: RENIEC - Directiva DI-001-GTAR-DRC Gestion Tecnica de Registros Civiles y Archivo Registral (primera version, 2026)
internal_guidance_examples.publisher: RENIEC Direccion de Registros Civiles (copy mirrored by LP Derecho; official copy on the RENIEC portal per El Peruano 16/09/2026)
internal_guidance_examples.note: 172-page registrar manual approved by Resolucion Secretarial D000040-2026-RENIEC/SGEN, marked 'INFORMACION PUBLICA' and 'Toda copia ... fuera del Portal WEB del RENIEC es una COPIA NO CONTROLADA'. Sections on registradores civiles, manual vs automated inscriptions in the SIRCM system, bilingual registry, mobile registry, calificacion registral for births/marriages/deaths, rectificacion administrativa, reposicion, cancelacion, observacion administrativa. Replaces DI-008-DRC/001 'Procedimientos del Registro Civil' (Dec 2022) 90 days after issue.

internal_guidance_examples.name: ONP - Directiva sobre la Calificacion de Prestaciones Previsionales del Sistema Nacional de Pensiones (RJ 141-2021-ONP/JF, 017-2022-ONP/JF, 097-2022-ONP/JF)
internal_guidance_examples.note: RJ 141-2021 (El Peruano 21/12/2021) approves Directiva 005-2021-ONP/JF and orders publication of the resolution and annex in El Peruano, gob.pe/onp and the PTE; RJ 017-2022 (lpderecho mirror opened) replaces it citing Directiva 001-2021-JF/ONP on ONP normative instruments; RJ 097-2022 approves Directiva 006-2022-ONP/JF (gob.pe CDN returned 403). Directive annex text not read in this survey. Related: RJ 096-2022 Directiva 005-2022 fiscalizacion de expedientes administrativos del SNP; RJ 089-2022 Directiva 003-2022 calculo actuarial.

internal_guidance_examples.name: ONP - RJ 000056-2026-JF-ONP Lineamientos para la remision de informacion y documentacion por entidades que pagan pensiones DL 20530
internal_guidance_examples.note: Full annex published as a 'separata especial' in El Peruano; article 2 'Disponese que la presente Resolucion sea puesta de conocimiento de los servidores de la entidad'; article 3 orders publication on gob.pe/onp and transparencia.gob.pe. Shows that ONP operating lineamientos are published in full.

internal_guidance_examples.name: Migraciones - Normativa Interna (Resoluciones de Superintendencia)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Predictable folder /Normativa Interna/Resoluciones de Superintendencia/<year>/RSnnn-<year>.pdf (directory listing itself is empty). RS063-2020 opened: a 7-page digitally signed resolution declaring lesividad of a residence visa, reciting ROF art. 48-49 verification functions of the Subgerencia de Verificacion y Fiscalizacion. Search results also show RS 229-2018, 404-2018, 064/065/132/163-2019 approving lineamientos on calidades migratorias.

internal_guidance_examples.name: SUNAT - RS 026-2001/SUNAT Reordenamiento de la politica de fiscalizacion o verificacion
internal_guidance_examples.note: Example of a tax-side (tributos internos) institutional rule: when audits start, suspend and end ('deberan ser culminadas dentro del plazo de quince (15) dias habiles'); it does not give step-level staff procedures. No step-level tax-side procedure manual was found.

appeals_sources.name: Tribunal Fiscal - Busqueda de Resoluciones (RTF)
appeals_sources.publisher: Ministerio de Economia y Finanzas - Tribunal Fiscal
appeals_sources.note: Search by RTF or expediente number, Sala (1-13, Quejas, Aduanas), year 1964-2026 and administration (SUNAT tributos internos, SUNAT aduanas, tributos municipales, otras). No free-text search field on this form (a separate nuevo_Contenido.htm is cited by third parties). RTF notified by publication appear as dated PDFs under mef.gob.pe/contenidos/tribu_fisc/jurisprude/notifica/. Annual 'Boletin de Jurisprudencia Fiscal' compendia (2023 opened: RTF 07112-2-2023 on loss of a fraccionamiento, RTF 00861-12-2023 on a refund request) and observance-mandatory precedents (art. 154 Codigo Tributario).

appeals_sources.name: INDECOPI - Buscador de Resoluciones
appeals_sources.note: Access to 'todas las resoluciones' by category: Tribunal del Indecopi, Propiedad Intelectual, Proteccion al Consumidor, Defensa de la Competencia, sentencias del Poder Judicial, laudos. The Comision de Eliminacion de Barreras Burocraticas rules on unlawful procedure requirements (e.g. Resolucion 0011-2025/SEL-INDECOPI declaring an EsSalud reimbursement deadline illegal, search result). Page showed a temporary technical-problems notice.

appeals_sources.name: Tribunal Constitucional - Jurisprudencia Sistematizada
appeals_sources.note: Constitutional amparo decisions (pension cases against ONP are a large share) are published here and under tc.gob.pe/jurisprudencia/; the search application is JavaScript-only ('Loading...') and the yearly directories returned 503, so coverage and search fields could not be verified.

appeals_sources.name: Poder Judicial - Jurisprudencia Nacional Sistematizada
appeals_sources.note: Contencioso-administrativo and Supreme Court casaciones; returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, not verified.

appeals_sources.name: Defensoria del Pueblo - Observatorio de Informes Defensoriales
appeals_sources.note: Ombudsman publishes thematic supervision reports (Informe Defensorial 289 on the school feeding programme, 07/10/2026, PDF, describes food-release and contracting procedures) with year tabs and Power BI indicators; individual case resolutions are not published (only 'Consulta tu caso' for the complainant).

appeals_sources.name: Tribunal del Servicio Civil (SERVIR), Tribunal Registral (SUNARP), Tribunal de Transparencia (TTAIP), Tribunal de Fiscalizacion Laboral (SUNAFIL), Tribunal de Contrataciones (OSCE/OECE)
appeals_sources.note: Sector appeal boards whose decisions are published on gob.pe collections; servir.gob.pe redirected to this gob.pe URL which returned HTTP 418, sunarp.gob.pe and sunafil.gob.pe returned 503, and the search budget ran out before their decision databases could be verified.

audit_office.name: Contraloria General de la Republica - Buscador de Informes de Control
audit_office.note: Supreme audit institution. Its site, appscontraloria.contraloria.gob.pe (not resolvable from this session) and doc.contraloria.gob.pe (empty response) could not be read; the 503 on the main site prevented opening any performance audit. Search results surfaced only an OCI (internal control organ) report Informe 024-2024-OCI/0635-SVC on ONP (vLex) and an ONP resolution on anti-fraud mechanisms. Whether 'auditorias de desempeno' describe agency processes is not established.

statistics_sources.name: Plataforma Nacional de Datos Abiertos - ONP and RENIEC service datasets
statistics_sources.publisher: PCM; datasets by ONP, RENIEC, SUNAT, MTPE, RREE
statistics_sources.note: About 100 ONP datasets (monthly CSV: afiliados SNP DL 19990, pensionistas y beneficiarios, bonos de reconocimiento, SCTR, ejecucion presupuestal); RENIEC 'Tramites realizados por los ciudadanos en las oficinas de atencion' (csv/xlsx), DNI procedures for vulnerable groups; RREE consular procedures; SUNAT padron RUC and electronic-invoice registers. No processing-time or decision-outcome series found; data.json endpoint timed out.

statistics_sources.name: SUNAT - Estadisticas y Estudios (Nota Tributaria)
statistics_sources.note: Monthly revenue (Ingresos Tributarios del Gobierno Central, August 2026), foreign trade, refunds as a revenue line; chart images, no per-procedure volumes or processing times on the page.

statistics_sources.name: INEI - Microdatos
statistics_sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadistica e Informatica

layer_scores.reason: Every entity must publish a TUPA with requisitos, fees, plazos and calificacion (Ley 27444 art. 43; standard format DS 062-2009-PCM), published in El Peruano and on gob.pe, and gob.pe serves a national tramites catalogue covering national and subnational bodies. No API or bulk export of TUPA/gob.pe records was found, SUT has no public consultation, and gob.pe could not be opened (HTTP 418), so the score rests on the TUPA norms opened on El Peruano and SUNAT's TUPA page.

SPIJ offers updated ('sistematizadas y actualizadas') texts, 210,000+ norms free of 500,000+, in Word/PDF, but with a paid tier and no API; El Peruano serves every norm as HTML/PDF by identifier (original texts); the Congress archive serves original acts as scanned PDFs with a vigencia flag; SUNAT keeps its procedures and resolutions as HTML with change logs. No Akoma Ntoso/XML or bulk access found.

orientacion.sunat.gob.pe gives about 100 topic pages for persons, firms and customs (RUC, devoluciones, fraccionamiento, recursos impugnatorios), Spanish only with one English page; gob.pe hosts per-service guidance pages for every entity (seen only through search results such as 'Cambiar calidad migratoria residente', since gob.pe returned 418). Detailed per-service guidance exists for the main agencies but no multilingual structured enumeration was verified.

Forms are published as PDF annexes of TUPAs and resolutions (DS 004-2023-MINAM sets 'formularios' for SERNANP; DESPA-PE.00.09 references Formato A declaration fields; RENIEC directive section 6.9 'formatos y formularios aplicables'). Forms libraries on gob.pe and SUNAT's formularios section could not be opened, so only scattered PDF forms are evidenced.

SUNAT publishes its customs operating procedures (28 DESPA-PG, ~20 DESPA-PE, 16 RECA) as versioned HTML with officer and system steps and an enumerable index; EsSalud lists 109 Manuales de Procesos y Procedimientos and 7 MOPE as PDFs plus all directive-approving resolutions; RENIEC's 172-page registrar directive DI-001-GTAR-DRC is public; ONP's pension-qualification directives and lineamientos are approved by Resolucion Jefatural and published with annex in El Peruano, gob.pe/onp and the PTE; Migraciones keeps a Normativa Interna PDF folder. Enumerable repositories exist for SUNAT customs and EsSalud. Gap: no step-level manual for SUNAT internal taxes and no separate system descriptions.

datosabiertos.gob.pe carries about 100 ONP datasets (monthly affiliates, pensioners, bonos, SCTR) and RENIEC/RREE counts of tramites by office as CSV; SUNAT publishes monthly revenue and trade statistics. Per-service volumes exist; processing times, decision outcomes and automation rates were not found.

Tribunal Fiscal decisions are searchable by number, sala, year (from 1964) and administration, with dated PDF notifications and annual compendia; INDECOPI has a resolution search across all its bodies; Defensoria publishes thematic reports but not case decisions. TC and PJ databases and the sector tribunals (SERVIR, Registral, TTAIP, SUNAFIL) could not be verified; no bulk access found.

notes: Access constraints shaped this pass: gob.pe (the single national portal that hosts every entity's tramites, TUPA, normas and informes) answers HTTP 418 to automated fetches, its CDN answers 403, and SPIJ, SUNARP, SEACE, Contraloria, Poder Judicial, SIS, SUNAFIL, MTC and several others answered 503/403; curl with a browser user agent was refused by the session's policy. Findings therefore rest on agency-owned domains (sunat.gob.pe, essalud.gob.pe, migraciones.gob.pe, mef.gob.pe, defensoria.gob.pe), El Peruano, transparencia.gob.pe, datosabiertos.gob.pe and mirrors (lpderecho.pe, minsa.gob.pe). Peru's structural strengths: a legal duty on every entity to publish a TUPA (Ley 27444 art. 43) and a PTE scheme under which entities link ROF, MAPRO/mapa de procesos and TUPA; and a strong practice of approving internal directivas by resolution published in El Peruano with the full annex. SUNAT customs procedures are the richest internal-step source found in any layer (versioned HTML with officer and system steps and change logs). Government sites publish in Spanish; Quechua appears only in SUNAT's TUPA summary, Agrobanco and RENIEC's bilingual registry provisions.
